study type: Longitudinal nested case-control within a birth cohort
exposure: Cord blood metabolome (medium and long chain fatty acids)
Cord blood metabolome (acetaminophen metabolites: 3-(N-acetyl-L-cystein-S-yl) acetaminophen, 2-hydroxyacetaminophen sulfate, 2-methoxyacetaminophen glucuronide, p-acetamidophenyl glucuronide)
cohort: The study participants consisted of 25 children who developed obesity by age 3-5 years and 25 sex-matched non-obese children, all from an ongoing birth cohort.
finding: Children who developed obesity by age 3-5 years had elevated levels of medium and long chain fatty acids and acetaminophen metabolites in their cord blood at birth.
